description: This file defines the LoggerLevelMatchFilter class, a filter component for the log4php logging framework. It filters log events based on matching log levels, with configurable acceptance on match or neutral decision. It depends on external helper classes for level conversion and implements filtering logic for log events.

classes.name: LoggerLevelMatchFilter
classes.description: A filter class that accepts or rejects log events based on level matching, with options for accept on match and level to match.

methods.name: getAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Returns whether the filter accepts on match (boolean).

methods.name: setAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Sets the accept on match flag using a boolean or string value.

methods.name: getLevelToMatch
methods.description: Returns the level object set for matching.

methods.name: setLevelToMatch
methods.description: Sets the level to match, converting from string if necessary.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Determines whether to accept, deny, or remain neutral for a log event based on level matching.
